newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: DMG underwriting Westpac debt raising.
newsitem.headline: DMG underwriting Westpac debt raising.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Australia said on Wednesday that it had signed an underwriting agreement with Westpac Banking Corporation relating to the raising of up to A$500 million through the issue of Westpac converting preference shares.
However, the underwriting commitment would not be activated unless Tier 1 capital was required as a result of the proposed Bank of Melbourne merger, DMG said.

"Deutsche Morgan Grenfell structured and packaged a facility that met all our requirements. This agreement formalises the commitment previously announced," said Pat Handley, Chief Financial Officier of Westpac.
The possibility of the new issue was disclosed when Westpac's results were released last week.

"We are pleased to be able to support Westpac with this innovative underwriting," said James Barnes, Chief Executive of Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, which was voted Europe's leading house in equity-linked securities by Euromoney in 1996.
